label: early copy-phase echo of l or 1 (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.8% of mass), at the first few copy steps (recall_idx 1-2 hold 95% of mass), when the input fed back is the letter l or the digit 1 (88% of mass), usually the echoed first original token. The strongest activations are short sequences starting with l and followed by q or g (e.g. l q g <DEL> [l] q); output q/g/2/1 raise the rate. It does not fire in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on other input tokens (except a few on x/h/g/q). The predicate covers about 83% of activation mass, but precision is very low (about 2%): the feature fires on only a small, unexplained subset of these contexts. Adding conditions on the output token or on L raises precision only to about 10-14% and costs a lot of recall.
